question: The average height of 20 students of class 8 is 152 cm and the average height of 15 students of class 9 is 168 cm. What is the average height (to the nearest cm) of the students of both classes?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of number of students in Class 8 and Class 9 = 20 : 15 = 4 : 3.

Let the assumed average be 152 cm.

Net deviation from assumed average = (168 − 152) × 3 = +48.

Average deviation = +48 ÷ (4 + 3) = 48 ÷ 7 ≈ +6.85 cm.

Combined average = 152 + 6.85 = 158.85 cm ≈ 159 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 159 cm.**
